Welcome to Quarto! Quarto is used for publishing documents with executable code chunks like the one below that displays your uv version:

```{python}
import subprocess

result = subprocess.run("uv --version", shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)

print(result.stdout)

with open("finished.txt", "w") as f:
	f.write(f"uv version: {result.stdout}")
```
